login.title: Technician sign-in
login.subtitle: Installation & Demo field partner app.
login.terms: By continuing you agree to the partner terms.

errors.sendFailed: Could not send a code. Try again.
errors.verifyFailed: That did not work. Try again.
errors.notTechnician: This number is not set up as a technician yet.
errors.noAccount: No technician account for this number — ask your manager for an invite.
errors.wrongCode: That code didn't match. Request a new one.

invite.title:
Welcome —
set up your account
invite.body: Your onboarding partner set these up for you. Confirm they're correct — you add the rest next.
invite.locked: Your mobile number is locked to this invite. Contact your ASM to change it.

errors.title: This invite couldn't be opened
errors.askForNewLink: Ask your manager to send a new link.
errors.unusable: This invite link can't be used. If you have already registered, sign in instead — otherwise ask your manager for a new link.

profile.title: Tell us who you are
profile.body: Your name and photo are what the customer sees when you arrive for a job.
profile.photoHint: Tap to add a clear face photo. You can change it later.
profile.fullNamePlaceholder: As it appears on your ID
profile.mobileHint: From your invite. Contact your ASM to change it.

coverage.title: What do you install?
coverage.body: Pick every category you're trained for. You'll only be offered jobs that match — pick more to get more work.
coverage.setBy: Set by {{name}}. You'll be offered jobs from any of these.
coverage.setByManager: Set by your manager. You'll be offered jobs from any of these.
coverage.noAreas: No areas assigned yet — ask your manager before you finish.

verify.title: Confirm your number
verify.codeSentTo: Enter the 6-digit code sent to <bold>{{phone}}</bold>. This is the last step.

errors.sendFailed: We could not send your code. Tap resend to try again.
errors.resendFailed: We could not send your code. Try again in a moment.
errors.incomplete: Registration did not complete. Ask your ASM for a new invite.
errors.submitFailed: We could not finish your registration. Try again.

barcode.title: Scan barcode
barcode.hint: Align the product barcode within the frame

serial.title: Serial number
serial.hint: Photograph the serial label, then type the number below

photos.title: Product photos
photos.hint: Capture the installed unit from 2–3 angles

live.title: Live site photo
live.hint: On-site live capture · gallery uploads not accepted

capture.cameraBody: Proof of installation must be captured live on site. Gallery uploads aren't accepted, so the job can't be completed without the camera.
capture.tooFar: You are {{distance}} from this job. The live photo must be taken at the customer's address.
capture.wrongPincode: You are at {{here}} — this job is at {{job}}. The live photo must be taken at the customer's address.
capture.finding: Finding your location before the live photo…
capture.permissionSettings: Location is turned off for this app. Open Settings and allow location, then try again.
capture.servicesOff: Location services are off on this phone. Switch them on, then try again.
capture.noFix: No location fix yet. Step outside or nearer a window and try again.
capture.allowLocation: Allow location to take the live photo — it proves you attended.
capture.captureBlocked: Capture unavailable until your location matches the job

helper.typeNow: Label photographed — now type the serial

review.title: Review & submit
review.intro: Tap any capture to see it full screen. Retake anything that isn't clear — after you submit, a blurry serial costs a second visit.
review.photosCount: {{n}} of {{max}} · tap one to see it
review.noLocation: No location was recorded with the live photo.

closure.title: Feedback link sent
closure.sentNamed: {{name}} received a WhatsApp link to confirm & rate the install.
closure.sent: The customer received a WhatsApp link to confirm & rate the install.
closure.note: If the customer doesn't respond in the set window, the ASM can force-close with supporting documents. Every closure records who, when and why.

verifying.title: Verifying with AI
verifying.body: Matching serial and product images against <bold>{{model}}</bold>.

result.mismatchBody: Serial doesn't match the order. Routed to the Area Service Manager.
result.whatNowBody: The ASM reviews your captures and the mismatch. You'll be notified once they approve or ask you to recapture.
result.unreadableBody: The serial photo is blurry. Retake before you leave the site.
result.unreadableTip: Steady the camera, avoid glare on the sticker, and fill the frame with the serial label.
result.passedBody: Serial and product match the order.

errorState.title: Something went wrong
errorState.body: We couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.

home.poolHint: Confirmed slots · tap to view the pool
home.emptyBody: Accept a job from the pool to fill your day.

pool.title: Open job pool
pool.intro: Jobs matching your category & pincodes. First to accept wins — customer details stay masked until you accept.
pool.offlineBody: Turn availability on from Home to start receiving offers.
pool.emptyBody: You've taken every open job nearby.
pool.tapAll: Tap {{all}} to see every open job.

accept.takenBody: Another technician accepted this job while you were deciding. It happens — the pool refreshes automatically.
accept.failedBody: Something went wrong accepting this job. Check your connection and try again.
accept.noTimeBody: The customer has not picked a time yet — they have the link. Accepting takes the job now; you will be told the time as soon as they choose it, and <bold>cancelling after that carries a penalty</bold>.
accept.confirmedBody: The customer already confirmed <bold>{{slot}}</bold>. Accepting locks you to that time — cancelling later carries a penalty.

detail.title: Job details
detail.escalated: This job has gone to your Area Service Manager. They will be in touch — there is nothing to do here.
detail.linkFailedNamed: Work submitted, but we could not message {{name}}. Ask them to confirm before you leave, or tell your manager.
detail.linkFailed: Work submitted, but we could not message the customer. Ask them to confirm before you leave, or tell your manager.
detail.linkSentNamed: Work submitted. {{name}} has been sent a link to confirm it — the job closes when they do.
detail.linkSent: Work submitted. The customer has been sent a link to confirm it — the job closes when they do.
detail.waitingNamed: Waiting for {{name}} to pick a time. You can start the job once they do, or once your manager sets one.
detail.waiting: Waiting for the customer to pick a time. You can start the job once they do, or once your manager sets one.
detail.managerReview: A manager will review this. Do not return to site until they call.

cancel.title: Cancel job
cancel.escalates: Under 1 hour to the slot — this escalates straight to the Area Service Manager for urgent reassignment.
cancel.failed: Could not cancel this job. Check your connection and try again.

reschedule.title: Reschedule visit
reschedule.failed: Could not update the time. Check your connection and try again.
reschedule.pickWithCustomer: Pick a new time with the customer
reschedule.noTimesBody: Your next two days are fully booked. Call your Area Service Manager — they can move this job to another technician.
reschedule.askForCode: Ask the customer for their code
reschedule.codeSent: We have sent a 6-digit code to the customer on WhatsApp. Ask them to read it out — it confirms they agreed to the new time.
reschedule.newCodeCancels: Sending a new code cancels the previous one.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

code.OFFLINE: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
code.SESSION_ENDED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
code.JOB_ALREADY_TAKEN: Another technician accepted this job first.
code.JOB_ESCALATED: This job has gone to your Area Service Manager.
code.NOT_ACCEPTING_WORK: You're not accepting work right now — turn availability back on to take jobs.
code.NO_WINDOW_LEFT: You have no free window left inside this job's service level. Finish or free up a day and it will come back.
code.DAILY_CAP_REACHED: You already have your daily limit of jobs on that day. Raise it under Availability & bandwidth.
code.NO_TIME_AGREED: The customer hasn't picked a time yet. You can start this job once they do, or once your manager sets one.
code.JOB_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This job can no longer be cancelled.
code.JOB_NOT_RESCHEDULABLE: This job can't be rescheduled right now. Refresh to see where it is.
code.SLOT_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE: That time is no longer free — pick another.
code.BAD_CODE: That code didn't match. Request a new one.
code.BALANCE_CHANGED: Your balance has changed. Check the new amount and try again.
code.NOTHING_TO_REDEEM: There is nothing to redeem yet.
code.REDEMPTION_OPEN: You already have a redemption open. It has to be paid and confirmed, or declined, before you can ask for another.
code.NOT_CLAIMED: Nobody has marked this as paid yet, so there is nothing to confirm.
code.ALREADY_CONFIRMED: You have already confirmed you received this.
code.UPI_ALREADY_SET: You already have a UPI ID. To change it, send a change request.
code.SAME_UPI_ID: That is already your UPI ID.
code.CHANGE_PENDING: You already have a change waiting. Withdraw it to ask for a different one.
code.NO_PENDING_CHANGE: There is no change waiting — it may already have been decided or withdrawn.
code.NO_PHONE: Your account has no mobile number to send a code to. Ask your manager.
code.TECHNICIAN_HAS_OPEN_JOBS: You still have open jobs. Finish them, or ask your manager to reassign them, first.
code.RANGE_TOO_LONG: Pick a shorter range of dates.
code.UPDATE_APP: Update the app to add or change your UPI ID.
